James Cameron's Avatar (2009) became the highest grossing film in history at $2.9 billion worldwide and won 3 Academy Awards, for Cinematography, Visual Effects, and Art Direction. But Cameron lost Best Director to his ex-wife Kathryn Bigelow for The Hurt Locker, making Bigelow the first woman to win Best Director in the award's 82 year history. Cameron was reportedly gracious, telling reporters backstage that she deserved it.
By 2026 the Avatar franchise had earned $7.6 billion combined across three films, an unprecedented commercial achievement. Yet the franchise has still never won Best Director. Avatar: Fire and Ash received only 2 Oscar nominations at the 98th Academy Awards, both in technical categories, the lowest showing for any Avatar film. It converted one of them, winning Best Visual Effects on the night of March 15, 2026. Despite generating more box office revenue than virtually any filmmaker in history, Cameron's relationship with the Academy stayed exactly where it has always been: spectacle earns the technical awards, and the directing prize keeps eluding his franchise work.

# James Cameron has now directed three of the top 10 highest-grossing films of all time
By C Mandler
January 9, 2023 / 5:29 PM EST / CBS News
Add CBS News on Google
Director James Cameron's newest film, "Avatar: The Way of Water," is now the seventh highest-grossing film ever — raking in $1.7 billion at the global box office — and the third of Cameron's films among the top 10 highest-grossing movies of all time, according to IMDb. All three films were released in different decades.
A screen displays Avatar: The Way of Water poster in a cinema at Times Square on Jan. 5, 2023, in New York City. Photo by Leonardo Munoz/VIEWpress via Getty Images
The other two of Cameron's films to break the top 10 are the No. 3 "Titanic," for which he won the best director Oscar in 1998, and 2009's original "Avatar," which is the highest-grossing movie of all time at $2.9 billion.
"Avatar 2" had a robust opening weekend during its December release, bringing in $134 million in its domestic debut. It is the highest-grossing film of 2022, beating "Top Gun: Maverick," which previously held the spot.
Cameron has said there will be three more Avatar sequels set to arrive every two years, with release dates in 2024, 2026 and 2028.

James Cameron (pictured in 2016) wrote, directed, and produced _Avatar_.
_Avatar_ was released in December 2009 and went on to break multiple box office records in various markets. Worldwide, it became the highest-grossing film of all time[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_box_office_records_set_by_Avatar#cite_note-at-1) and the fastest film to gross $1 billion through $2.5 billion,[[a]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_box_office_records_set_by_Avatar#cite_note-7) while also achieving the highest grosses in both the 3D[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_box_office_records_set_by_Avatar#cite_note-boxofficemojo1-8) and IMAX[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_box_office_records_set_by_Avatar#cite_note-9) formats.

In its domestic market of the United States and Canada, it set the records for the highest-grossing film[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_box_office_records_set_by_Avatar#cite_note-or-10) and the highest-grossing second through seventh weekends,[[b]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_box_office_records_set_by_Avatar#cite_note-17) as well as becoming the fastest film to gross $500 million through $750 million.[[c]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_box_office_records_set_by_Avatar#cite_note-24) Elsewhere, it became the highest-grossing film of all time in over 30 markets including China,[[22]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_box_office_records_set_by_Avatar#cite_note-ic-25)Hong Kong,[[d]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_box_office_records_set_by_Avatar#cite_note-28)Romania,[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_box_office_records_set_by_Avatar#cite_note-boxofficemojo1-8)South Korea,[[25]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_box_office_records_set_by_Avatar#cite_note-boxofficemojo3-29)[[26]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_box_office_records_set_by_Avatar#cite_note-ci-30)Taiwan,[[27]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_box_office_records_set_by_Avatar#cite_note-boxofficemojo5-31) and the United Kingdom.[[27]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_box_office_records_set_by_Avatar#cite_note-boxofficemojo5-31)

Box office analysts identified several factors contributing to the film's success. Among these were the relative lack of competition owing to the release date, a marketing strategy that emphasized the novelty of the cinematic experience which led viewers to watch it in the theater rather than at home, positive word of mouth and repeat viewings increasing the film's staying power in theaters, an ability to attract audiences across the globe, and higher ticket prices from 3D and IMAX showings.[[e]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_box_office_records_set_by_Avatar#cite_note-37) Many of the records set by the film are listed below. Pre-_Avatar_ records and new records surpassing _Avatar_ are presented where available and applicable. All grosses are given in unadjusted US dollars, except where noted otherwise.
_Avatar_ set the worldwide record for the highest gross of all time, surpassing the previous record by more than 50%, and grossed $2 billion in less time than it had taken the previous fastest-grossing film to gross half as much. The film also exceeded the previous record for highest gross in the IMAX format by a factor of more than three.

But Cameron lost Best Director to his ex-wife Kathryn Bigelow for The Hurt Locker, making Bigelow the first woman to win Best Director in the award's 82 year history. Cameron was reportedly gracious, telling reporters backstage that she deserved it.
By 2026 the Avatar franchise had earned $7.6 billion combined across three films, an unprecedented commercial achievement. Yet the franchise has still never won Best Director. Avatar: Fire and Ash received only 2 Oscar nominations at the 98th Academy Awards, both in technical categories, the lowest showing for any Avatar film. It converted one of them, winning Best Visual Effects on the night of March 15, 2026. Despite generating more box office revenue than virtually any filmmaker in history, Cameron's relationship with the Academy stayed exactly where it has always been: spectacle earns the technical awards, and the directing prize keeps eluding his franchise work.

# James Cameron has now directed three of the top 10 highest-grossing films of all time
By C Mandler
January 9, 2023 / 5:29 PM EST / CBS News
Add CBS News on Google
Director James Cameron's newest film, "Avatar: The Way of Water," is now the seventh highest-grossing film ever — raking in $1.7 billion at the global box office — and the third of Cameron's films among the top 10 highest-grossing movies of all time, according to IMDb. All three films were released in different decades.
A screen displays Avatar: The Way of Water poster in a cinema at Times Square on Jan. 5, 2023, in New York City. Photo by Leonardo Munoz/VIEWpress via Getty Images
The other two of Cameron's films to break the top 10 are the No. 3 "Titanic," for which he won the best director Oscar in 1998, and 2009's original "Avatar," which is the highest-grossing movie of all time at $2.9 billion.
"Avatar 2" had a robust opening weekend during its December release, bringing in $134 million in its domestic debut. It is the highest-grossing film of 2022, beating "Top Gun: Maverick," which previously held the spot.
Cameron has said there will be three more Avatar sequels set to arrive every two years, with release dates in 2024, 2026 and 2028.

# ‘Avengers: Endgame’ Overtakes ‘Avatar’ Again As Highest Grossing Movie Ever At Global Box Office
## Services to share this page.
Disney/Marvel Studio’s _Avengers: Endgame_ is once again, the highest grossing movie ever, overtaking _Avatar_, $2.9255 billion to the latter’s $2.9237 billion.
This is all due to the re-release of the Anthony and Joe Russo directed movie in the tee-up to their _Avengers: Doomsday_ upside down multiverse movie on Dec. 18.
_Endgame_ was king of the world at the box office once before when it was announced at Comic-Con 2019 that the movie beaten the James Cameron Na’Vi film.
The re-release of _Endgame,_ entitled, _Avengers: Endgame Encore_ plummeted in its second weekend with $4.4M, -81% from its No. 1 notch last weekend with a $26.1M start. The pic’s running stateside cume is $894.6M, the No. 3 off all-time behind _Spider-Man: Brand New Day_($954.4M) and _Star Wars: Force Awakens_($936.6M).

# 'Avengers: Endgame' takes the box office crown back from 'Avatar'
October 6, 2026 8:19 AM ET
Bob Mondello
Josh Brolin as Thanos in _Avengers: Endgame._**Marvel Studios******hide caption****
**toggle caption**i
Marvel Studios
_Avengers: Endgame_ has reclaimed the number one spot on Hollywood's all-time worldwide box office chart.
The superhero epic, in which dozens of Marvel superheroes oppose Thanos, a supervillain who has erased half the universe's population, first became the highest grossing film in history in 2019.
Its $2.799 billion total eclipsed that of James Cameron's sci-fi epic _Avatar_ (2009), which had held that title for ten years.
Then _Avatar,_ which tells the story of an Indigenous population fighting off a human invasion on the moon Pandora,was re-released in 2022 to drum up interest in a sequel, _Avatar: The Way of Water._ That re-release, combined with a first-time release in China, earned enough to allow _Avatar_ to retake the top spot.
Sponsor Message
Now, it's the _Avengers_ franchise that has a sequel coming — _Avengers: Doomsday_, arriving in theaters on December 18. So, following the same playbook, _Endgame_ has been re-released, and has reclaimed the crown with a new worldwide total of $2.9255 billion.
It's a friendly competition — both films are Disney releases. And while those numbers are impressive, their jockeying reflects rising ticket prices more than rising attendance.

From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia  
The film's official logo
Avengers: Endgame is the fourth Avengers film and the 22nd film in the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU), released seven years after the first Avengers film and eleven years after the first MCU film. Directed by Anthony and Joe Russo, the film features an ensemble cast of actors reprising their roles from previous entries in the MCU.
Endgame was released on April 26, 2019, and went on to break numerous box office records in various markets. Worldwide, it set the record for highest-grossing film of all time,[1] the highest opening weekend gross,[2] and the fastest cumulative grosses through $2.5 billion.[3][4][5][6][7] In its domestic market of the US and Canada, it set the records for the highest-grossing opening weekend,[8] single day,[9] Friday,[10] Saturday,[11] and Sunday[12] as well as the fastest cumulative grosses through $650 million.[13] Elsewhere, it became the highest-grossing film of all time in several markets including Chile and Thailand,[14] set the record for highest opening weekend gross in more than 40 markets[15] including Australia, Brazil, China, Egypt, Mexico, and the United Kingdom,[16] and set various IMAX records in 50 different markets across all six inhabited continents.[14][16][17][18] Many of the records set by the film are listed below. Data on the previous record and records that have since been surpassed are presented where available and applicable. All grosses are given in unadjusted US dollars, except where noted otherwise.
Worldwideedit
Worldwide, Endgame grossed more money faster than any previous film. It also set the records for the highest-grossing opening weekend in total as well as in the IMAX and 3D formats.

# 'Avengers: Endgame' takes the box office crown back from 'Avatar'
October 6, 2026 8:19 AM ET
Bob Mondello
Josh Brolin as Thanos in _Avengers: Endgame._**Marvel Studios******hide caption****
**toggle caption**i
Marvel Studios
_Avengers: Endgame_ has reclaimed the number one spot on Hollywood's all-time worldwide box office chart.
The superhero epic, in which dozens of Marvel superheroes oppose Thanos, a supervillain who has erased half the universe's population, first became the highest grossing film in history in 2019.
Its $2.799 billion total eclipsed that of James Cameron's sci-fi epic _Avatar_ (2009), which had held that title for ten years.
Then _Avatar,_ which tells the story of an Indigenous population fighting off a human invasion on the moon Pandora,was re-released in 2022 to drum up interest in a sequel, _Avatar: The Way of Water._ That re-release, combined with a first-time release in China, earned enough to allow _Avatar_ to retake the top spot.
Sponsor Message
Now, it's the _Avengers_ franchise that has a sequel coming — _Avengers: Doomsday_, arriving in theaters on December 18. So, following the same playbook, _Endgame_ has been re-released, and has reclaimed the crown with a new worldwide total of $2.9255 billion.
It's a friendly competition — both films are Disney releases. And while those numbers are impressive, their jockeying reflects rising ticket prices more than rising attendance.
